expectedIssues: Restaurant cover image failed to load
reportedIssues: The first card in 'Popular right now' (Tokumaru Ramen Bar) shows a grey broken-image placeholder instead of a restaurant photo, while the card below renders a proper image.
In 'Fastest near you' the third card is cut off mid-title ('Trattoria Piccol') with no ellipsis, so it reads as clipped text rather than an intentional peeking carousel item.
The category chip row is clipped at the right edge, showing a sliver of the next chip with no visible affordance that the row scrolls.

Favourite (heart) buttons are inconsistently styled: the top card uses a light grey semi-transparent circle with white heart (low contrast against the grey placeholder), the card below uses a dark circle.
The bottom pizza card is abruptly clipped by the bottom navigation bar with no visible bottom padding, making the list look cut off rather than scrollable.
The 'Popular right now' cards mix info inside the image (badges like '€0 delivery' and '−20%') with no visible text alternative, and the broken image gives no context for screen readers.
